_comment: Profile sources the site builds downloadable codeplugs from.
tools/build_site_artifacts.py reads this, resolves every listed profile
against the listed SSRF roots, and writes site/codeplugs/. A profile that
fails to resolve fails the build -- this file is the project's end-to-end
integration test as much as it is site content.
'checkout' names a sibling directory, not a path: the builder resolves it
under --checkout-root, which defaults to this repository's parent. That
way a developer with the usual ~/src/ layout runs the builder with no
flags, and CI passes the directory it cloned into.
A source with no 'checkout' ships in this repository and resolves against
the ssrf-lite revision pyproject.toml pins, so it needs nothing cloned.
ssrf_roots are listed in precedence order, same as repeated --ssrf-root.
Which file formats a profile produces is NOT listed here. It comes from
the radio's row in site/radios.json, so a radio cannot advertise an
export column in the support table and then fail to offer the file.
'i18n' holds per-language overrides of 'name' and 'description' for the
translated downloads pages; a language without an entry falls back to

sources.name: Use-case starter codeplugs
sources.description: Buy a supported radio and make it behave like the radio you wanted: a GMRS handheld, a PMR446 handheld, a MURS handheld, a marine VHF receiver, or all of them at once. Built from published ssrf-lite data only, with no personal DMR IDs. GMRS needs an FCC licence and the marine channels are receive-only; see the reference sheet in each download.

es.name: Codeplugs iniciales por caso de uso
es.description: Compra una radio compatible y haz que se comporte como la radio que querías: un portátil GMRS, un portátil PMR446, un portátil MURS, un receptor VHF marino, o todos a la vez. Compilados solo con datos publicados de ssrf-lite, sin IDs DMR personales. GMRS requiere una licencia de la FCC y los canales marinos son solo de recepción; consulta la hoja de referencia en cada descarga.

sources.name: Chicago Offline community net
sources.description: Shared GMRS and MURS channels for the Chicago Offline community net. Instance-agnostic: no personal DMR IDs, no per-operator settings.

es.name: Red comunitaria de Chicago Offline
es.description: Canales GMRS y MURS compartidos de la red comunitaria de Chicago Offline. Independientes de la instancia: sin IDs DMR personales, sin ajustes por operador.
